text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I just love coming to the beach! My
heart
races with every trip!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I have to say, your driving
makes my
heart race just as much.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? But the real excitement is yet to
come.
There's a place I've been dying to
go to!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, how beautiful! The interior is quite

classical. It's like a time capsule in here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I knew you'd feel that way. This
place just
screamed "hip" when I passed
it by!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Check out these lights! This is an antique
French
chandelier from the nineteenth
century. And the
other ornaments are
just as impressive...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, we've got one day for this trip,
so let's
enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and this gorgeous spa is to die for! I
have to
get a good soak in. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hotel Concierge
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I would like to offer you two
a drink
on the house.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how nice of you! Could I have a
glass of
sparkling water with a slice of
lemon? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna, you order something too! Don't
let the
jacuzzi turn you to jelly!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I had myself a wonderful time! I
rarely eat
French cuisine, so I'd long
forgotten how
delicious it can be!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Both the amuse-bouche and the dessert
were
perfect! I love a good Italian dish,
but French
feels right for this hotel!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mister garçon, could you give my
compliments to
the chef? The food was
impeccable!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm so impressed! This resort is the bee's
knees!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your gracious comments. I
am the
manager in charge of this hotel.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
If I could trouble you with a question...
Was there
anything not to your liking
thus far?

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't have to be anything
significant, but I
implore you to give me
your honest opinion,
without any frills.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... but nothing exactly comes to
mind. Is
this a simple feedback session,
or is there more to
your question?

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
I am most embarrassed to say this, but
the truth
is...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What? You're at risk of closing?

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We've been in the red for some
time, with
the new resort in the area
garnering most of the
attention. Time is
not on our side, unfortunately...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
However, we're hoping to try something
with this
renovation project we're
planning...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, if I've got this right, you want our
feedback to
help with ideas to improve
the facility.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Is there any room for improvement?
Hm... I do
want to help, but I have
nothing but compliments
for this place.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Me too... But I can't turn a blind eye.
This hotel is
your pride—losing it would
be absolutely awful.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! How does this sound? I could help
out with
the renovation!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For instance... I could be an ambassador
of sorts!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, I have quite a lot of

connections! I'd be able to convince
loads of
people of this place's charm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
W-would you really do that for us?!
Thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"A seaside resort, I'm in the mood for
romance."
Hm... it's not as
trendy-sounding as I hoped.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen has become the ambassador for
a hotel
resort! She's currently working on
the lyrics for
their theme song...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"A seaside resort, Love is in the air."
Hmm...
Yeah, this is it! I've got my first
line! Coming up
with the rest should be a
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The catchy song becomes a hit on
campus, and
the resort enjoys a boost in
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now to take it easy with a nice and
relaxing
drive! ♪ Tazuna is busy with
work, so... care to fill
her spot?
